# Lemon8 User Profile Details API

Access profile details for a specific Lemon8 account using the `user_id` parameter.

## Use cases

- Inspect profile details of a Lemon8 user account.
- Display account information within social analytics dashboards.
- Verify user details retrieved from identity lookup endpoints.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/lemon8/app/user-profile" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id": "7217844966059656197"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | string | Yes | User ID, can be obtained from the interface `/lemon8/app/get_user_id` |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "server_time": "1791290353.18"
}
```

## Notes

- The `user_id` value can be obtained from the `/lemon8/app/get_user_id` endpoint.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Lemon8 Discover Page Banners](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-banners): Returns the current promotional and featured banners displayed on the Lemon8 discover page.
- [Lemon8 Discover Page Content](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-tab): Returns the main content featured on the Lemon8 discover tab.
- [Lemon8 Discover Editor Picks](/apis/lemon8/app/discover-tab-information-tabs): Returns the Editor's Picks and discover tab information from the Lemon8 mobile app.
